note: Rue du Commerce — étape 7: one-point street view walking down Rue du Commerce. -er verbs on the LEFT houses, -ir/-re on the RIGHT. Tiers: street (commonest) -> balcony -> upper -> roof (rarest). One box per verb (reflexives include their oval mirror). Forward exit = the far road; back = the near cobbles.

ginger cat tipping coins from its jar to pay the waiter's bill

three geese in cowboy hats taking a sack of loot from a fox on the roof
